programs.name: Two-Year Master of Business Administration (MBA)

feeSource.title: IIM Udaipur MBA 2026-28 Batch Fee Structure (Regular and International)
feeSource.quote: No whole-programme total is stated; only term-wise totals: 'Fee paid at the time of accepting the offer of admission 1,00,000' + Term I 'Total 3,29,955', Term II '3,83,298', Term III '3,79,255', Term IV '3,56,250', Term V '3,51,250', Term VI '3,51,250' (include Rs 20,000 refundable caution deposit and mess charges). Arithmetic sum = Rs 22,51,258 (computed, not officially stated). The 2027-29 fee table is also published on https://mba.iimu.ac.in/fees-financing/ (term totals 3,19,250 / 3,99,250 / 3,99,250 / 3,65,000 / 3,60,000 / 3,60,000 + 1,00,000 acceptance; mess excluded) — sum Rs 23,02,750 computed.

programs.salaryNote: Median Maximum Earning Potential, MBA 2024-26 final placement audit report (auditor's letter dated 15 Oct 2026; file name says '3rd-draft'). Median guaranteed cash component: INR 14,01,626.

salarySource.title: IIM Udaipur MBA Final Placement Audit Report 2024-26 (Sorab S. Engineer & Co., dated October 15, 2026)
salarySource.quote: Median maximum earning potential Rs. 18,01,861 ... Table 5.4 combined: 'Maximum Earning Potentials 10,00,000 41,65,900 18,01,861 18,76,868 317'. (Median Total guaranteed Cash Component = 14,01,626; filename says '3rd-draft' though it carries the auditor's letter.) NIRF 2025 cross-check: median 1800000 for graduates of 2023-24 (https://www.nirfindia.org/nirfpdfcdn/2025/pdf/Management/IR-M-S-8942.pdf).
